correctness.rationale: Writing v=-log(1-u) converts the published score to v^(beta-1)(beta+1-v)/Gamma(beta+1), which tends to -infinity as u approaches 1 from below for every beta>0. Equation (7) evaluates that score at i/n through i=n, and equation (9) places the same endpoint term in every spacing coefficient. The derivative is proportional to beta^2-1-beta v, proving the all-beta strict-monotonicity assertion false when beta>1.
